skeleton.identical_to: AP-006 rig_template_v001 / AP-007 ZombieRig; Unity Humanoid
skeleton.in_place: Root never moves; Hips carries bob/sink only; locomotion is code-driven (CharacterAnimationSet.SpeedParameterFor)

events.convention: frame index at 30 fps from the clip start; also stored as Blender pose markers on the action and as the armature custom property AP009_events ('name=frame;…') in each FBX

names.hit_window_start/hit_window_end: attack active window (DEC-029: the hitbox is ON only between these frames)

layers.override_upper: upper-body override layer (hit reactions) — play at weight 1 over locomotion, mask Spine+
layers.additive: additive layer (recoil, regional flinches): first frame is the reference pose (deltas from rest)
layers.aim_layer: WP-018: rotate Spine/Chest/UpperChest toward the aim direction on top of the base (REQ-038)

speed_reference: speed_mps = the measured ground speed at which the in-place cycle shows no foot slide (mean stance-foot ankle displacement x 30 fps; playback rate 1.0). Unity scales the playback rate by MoveSpeed / speed_mps — see README §speed table; v002: dedicated player run cycles (run_fwd/back/strafe_l/r, flight phase) — blend walk->run above ~1.6x the walk speed_mps (walk scaled beyond x2.1 reads as skating)

clips.maps_to: ZombieAttackStyle bite_grab / tier-agnostic (default telegraph 0.47 s native = 14 f; rate-scaled to 0.6-0.7 s)
Special lightning (Raiju) hit loop — S-06 WP-071 #73
Special lightning (Raiju) death — S-06 WP-071 #81 (continues hit_electro_loop)
Special gel (Namekuji) slip — S-06 WP-071 #74 (lethal: same clip ends at death_end)
